title: A 1991 Rule Kept Drones Off This Cell Band
description: The US FCC voted to open fifty megahertz of the 800 megahertz cellular band to drones, lifting a 1991 ban on airborne use of that band. The reporting gives no technical conditions or start date yet, and this is a US rule only.

caption:
Drones were banned from this cell band for 35 years. Now the US is lifting it. 📡
The FCC voted to open 50 MHz of the 800 MHz cellular band to drones. The 1991 rule feared one airborne phone could hit many towers at once; the FCC now says modern networks manage that interference.
The catch: no conditions or start date reported yet, and it's a US rule only.
Should Nepal let drones use phone networks? Comment yes or no, with your reason.
